mainEntity.name: How does GEO help businesses in New York City stand out?

acceptedAnswer.text: In competitive markets like New York City, GEO helps businesses stand out by refining their online visibility to target specific neighborhoods or boroughs. This allows a small business to compete effectively against larger chains by focusing on relevance to local searchers. Optimized Google Business Profiles, localized content, and managing online reviews tailored to NYC's diverse areas are key strategies.
